description: For tech-product marketing teams — turns a product knowledge base into brand-side long-form drafts (blogs, case studies, product write-ups), not third-party analysis. Produces only 1500-3000 word long-form drafts from a content brief; does not handle social posts, short content, or channel adaptation. Not for neutral industry research — use industry-deep-dive-pipeline for that.
